#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int countSmaller(const vector<int>& arr, int startIdx, int val) {
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = startIdx; i < arr.size() && arr[i] < val; i++) {
        count++;
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int length;
    cin >> length;
    string sequence;
    cin >> sequence;

    vector<int> vIndices, kIndices, xIndices;
    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        if (sequence[i] == 'V') {
            vIndices.push_back(i);
        } else if (sequence[i] == 'K') {
            kIndices.push_back(i);
        } else {
            xIndices.push_back(i);
        }
    }

    int vCount = vIndices.size();
    int kCount = kIndices.size();
    int xCount = xIndices.size();

    // Initialize 4D DP array with size (vCount+1) x (kCount+1) x (xCount+1) x 2
    vector<vector<vector<vector<long long>>>> dpArray(
        vCount + 1,
        vector<vector<vector<long long>>>(
            kCount + 1,
            vector<vector<long long>>(
                xCount + 1,
                vector<long long>(2, LLONG_MAX)
            )
        )
    );

    dpArray[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int vIdx = 0; vIdx <= vCount; vIdx++) {
        for (int kIdx = 0; kIdx <= kCount; kIdx++) {
            for (int xIdx = 0; xIdx <= xCount; xIdx++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                    long long currentCost = dpArray[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx][t];
                    if (currentCost == LLONG_MAX) continue;

                    if (vIdx < vCount) {
                        int posV = vIndices[vIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vIndices, vIdx, posV) +
                                    countSmaller(kIndices, kIdx, posV) +
                                    countSmaller(xIndices, xIdx, posV);
                        dpArray[vIdx + 1][kIdx][xIdx][1] = min(dpArray[vIdx + 1][kIdx][xIdx][1], currentCost + moves);
                    }
                    if (kIdx < kCount && t == 0) {
                        int posK = kIndices[kIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vIndices, vIdx, posK) +
                                    countSmaller(kIndices, kIdx, posK) +
                                    countSmaller(xIndices, xIdx, posK);
                        dpArray[vIdx][kIdx + 1][xIdx][0] = min(dpArray[vIdx][kIdx + 1][xIdx][0], currentCost + moves);
                    }
                    if (xIdx < xCount) {
                        int posX = xIndices[xIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vIndices, vIdx, posX) +
                                    countSmaller(kIndices, kIdx, posX) +
                                    countSmaller(xIndices, xIdx, posX);
                        dpArray[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx + 1][0] = min(dpArray[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx + 1][0], currentCost + moves);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long minTotal = LLONG_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        minTotal = min(minTotal, dpArray[vCount][kCount][xCount][i]);
    }

    cout << minTotal << "\n";

    return 0;
}
